raw:
The paper builds and implements a RAG system (a local knowledge base in vector databases, retrieved PDFs given to a language model). Voice is only an input layer through speech-to-text, so the RAG itself is text-based and not multimodal-only. The abstract describes system implementation and not explicit experiments, but the rules say to include papers that propose a RAG method and not to exclude for a missing baseline or metrics. It is not a survey. INCLUDE is appropriate, though a MAYBE is arguable because experiments are not clearly stated.

{"decision": "INCLUDE", "code": null, "reason": "Proposes and implements a text-based RAG chatbot with vector retrieval; voice is only an input layer."}
